title.narrative: The Recovery Spending Watchdog

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Project is to strengthen efficient and accountable public reconstruction and recovery spending, specifically it is focusing on:

¿ formulation of key recovery spending guidelines based on international experience;

¿ monthly monitoring of the recovery and reconstruction spending from publicly available sources;

¿ ensuring open access to the information within Ukrainian society;

¿ support the Ukrainian Government in making better decisions on funding the recovery through a number of written analytical reports and policy briefs, organised expert discussions and conducted meetings with government representatives

¿ monitoring of recovery and reconstruction at local / regions level..

The Project outcomes are designed to strengthen the environment for the reconstruction and recovery policies that will lead to more accountability of the performance of the governmental authorities and therefore more effective public spending on reconstruction.
